name: Hidaka Mai
source:
A cheerful and somewhat meddlesome senior employee who works at the same company of Shouma. As an instructor for newcomers she watched over Shouma in his training.
Shortly after finishing training she was engaged to and married the boss of her company, she still currently works in the same company with her husband.
However in recent years there has been problems in her marriage causing worry.
